answer: When merged identities disagree on history, the conflict is settled by a vote weighted by each identity verified reputation, so the more established record prevails. A Sybil attacker cannot outvote a real identity with fresh fake ones, because new identities carry almost no weight, and the vote outcome is published for audit. One haven proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of continuity. A nadir and a juniper may look alike, but only the claim with a valid proof is honoured.
